headline: Committee defers subdivision water review bill for board input

meeting.body: Maui County Council Water and Infrastructure Committee
meeting.summary: The Water and Infrastructure Committee deferred Bill 1, about subdivision water reviews, until the Board of Water Supply comments.
meeting.recap: The only item was Bill 1, 2026, about water availability rules for subdivision construction plans.[[0:03:35]] The chair said developers must still show written proof of long-term water before plans are approved.[[0:04:22]] The chair said the bill lets water supply staff review plans alongside other departments.[[0:04:50]] A Pacific Rim Land representative testified in support of the bill.[[0:09:34]] A testifier objected to changing the word "shall" to "may," saying "may" creates uncertainty.[[0:13:29]] A Board of Water Supply member, speaking as an individual, urged the committee to file the bill or delay action.[[0:24:20]] Another testifier said the bill would take away the department's choice in ordering its reviews.[[0:28:24]] The chief engineer for water said water supply has often been the last department to finish its review.[[0:44:33]] The chair supported sending the bill back to the Board of Water Supply for review.[[1:40:38]] The chair agreed to a member's request to go back to the word "shall.".[[1:43:48]] The committee deferred, or put off, the bill until the Board of Water Supply comments.[[1:45:06]]
meeting.next: The bill goes to the Board of Water Supply for its comments before more discussion. A member asked that the department be asked how it prioritizes reviews, and the chair said this was noted.

moments.q: "This bill does not authorize development without water."
"May to me is a word that creates uncertainty"
Bill deferred for Board of Water Supply comments
